records.title: LongVideoAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning with Long Videos
records.reason: LongVideoAgent studies multi-agent video reasoning capability, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Text Generation with Diffusion Language Models: A Pre-training Approach with Continuous Paragraph Denoise
records.reason: GENIE uses an iterative diffusion decoder that generates sequence embeddings in parallel, but the paper’s primary contribution/evaluation is a pretraining objective and downstream generation quality; it gives no inference speed, memory, or throughput results. This leaves a weak possible connection to parallel decoding, not a demonstrated serving improvement.

records.title: Why do LLMs attend to the first token?
records.reason: Analyzes first-token attention-sink formation and context-length effects, but no cache eviction/reuse or inference acceleration is tested.

records.title: FuseMoE: Mixture-of-Experts Transformers for Fleximodal Fusion
records.reason: FuseMoE studies multimodal fusion architecture, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: BrowseComp-ZH: Benchmarking Web Browsing Ability of Large Language Models in Chinese
records.reason: BrowseComp-ZH is a web-browsing capability benchmark.
